cards.headline: Artificial intelligence applications in biofilm research

source.title: Artificial intelligence applications in biofilm research: computational approaches for biofilm analysis and antimicrobial prediction.
source.excerpt: Overall, this review shows how AI could help improve the accuracy, integration, and tailoring of biofilm research and antimicrobial management.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence for Early Cancer Detection in Nigeria

source.title: Artificial Intelligence for Early Cancer Detection in Nigeria: A Contextual Narrative Review of Applications, Barriers, and Implementation Pathways.
source.excerpt: AI offers transformative potential for early cancer detection in Nigeria, but success requires staged implementation: short-term pilots in teaching hospitals, medium-term development of national AI guidelines and workforce training, and long-term integration into cancer control plans.

source.title: Totenhütte von Benzingerode
source.excerpt: Die Totenhütte von Benzingerode ist ein bei archäologischen Untersuchungen im Nordosten von Benzingerode im nördlichen Harz entdecktes Gemeinschaftsgrab, das anhand der geborgenen Funde der jungsteinzeitlichen Bernburger Kultur zugeordnet werden kann.

cards.headline: Effectiveness of the flipped classroom in medical education

source.title: Effectiveness of the flipped classroom in medical education: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Flipped classrooms were associated with improved outcomes in medical education, with larger effects in residents. Given high heterogeneity and limited evidence in some domains, benefits appear context dependent. Implementation should be tailored, and future studies should define mechanisms and optimal conditions.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Diabetes Mellitus Management

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Diabetes Mellitus Management: A Narrative Review of Advances, Architectures, and Translational Challenges.
source.excerpt: AI has the potential to transform DM care through more precise forecasting, earlier complication detection, and individualized treatment.

cards.headline: Levosimendan vs. Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump in Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting

source.title: Levosimendan vs. Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump in Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: A Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: Levosimendan may improve recovery and hemodynamic outcomes in high-risk CABG patients compared to IABP but may be associated with a higher, though non-significant, risk of mediastinitis. Further high-quality studies are warranted.

source.title: Synthetic artificial intelligence in cardiology: from generative models to clinical applications.
source.excerpt: As investment grows and methods mature, cardiologists must shape this evolution-not as passive adopters, but as active drivers. This review invites them to take the wheel.

cards.headline: Clinical utility of LLMs in otology and neurotology: a systematic review and meta-analysis

source.title: Clinical utility of LLMs in otology and neurotology: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.publisher: European archives of oto-rhino-laryngology : official journal of the European Federation of Oto-Rhino-Laryngological Societies (EUFOS) : affiliated with the German Society for Oto-Rhino-Laryngology - Head and Neck Surgery
source.excerpt: GPT-based LLMs show promise for patient education and knowledge-based tasks in otology and neurotology. However, their limited performance in diagnostic and therapeutic decision-making supports their use as adjuncts rather than replacements for clinician judgment.

source.title: Acidic cannabinoids in brain disorders: Neurobiological mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and translational challenges.

cards.headline: eine der anderen Nachkommenschaft. Und Allah ist Allhörend und Allwissend.

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:34
source.excerpt: هؤلاء الأنبياء والرسل سلسلة طُهْر متواصلة في الإخلاص لله وتوحيده والعمل بوحيه. والله سميع لأقوال عباده، عليم بأفعالهم، وسيجازيهم على ذلك.

cards.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
cards.translation: eine der anderen Nachkommenschaft. Und Allah ist Allhörend und Allwissend.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Chosen Ones Among the People of the Earth: Allah states that He has chosen these households over the people of the earth. For instance, Allah chose Adam, created him with His Hand and blew life into him.

cards.headline: Als ’Imrans Frau sagte: „Mein Herr, ich gelobe Dir, was in meinem Mutterleib ist …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:35
source.excerpt: اذكر -أيها الرسول- ما كان من أمر مريم وأمها وابنها عيسى عليه السلام; لتردَّ بذلك على من ادعوا أُلوهية عيسى أو بنوَّته لله سبحانه، إذ قالت امرأة عمران حين حملت: يا ربِّ إني جعلت لك ما في بطني خالصا لك، لخدمة «بيت المقدس» ، فتقبَّل مني; إنك أنت وحدك السميع لدعائي، العليم بنيتي.

cards.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
cards.translation: Als ’Imrans Frau sagte: „Mein Herr, ich gelobe Dir, was in meinem Mutterleib ist, für Deinen Dienst freigestellt. So nimm (es) von mir an! Du bist ja der Allhörende und Allwissende.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Story of Maryam's Birth: The wife of `Imran mentioned here is the mother of Maryam, and her name is Hannah bint Faqudh. Muhammad bin Ishaq mentioned that Hannah could not have children and that one day, she saw a bird feeding its chick.
